title: Instance-Optimal Adaptive Location Estimation via Multiscale Mid-Summaries
summary: Location estimation exhibits markedly different finite-sample behavior across noise distributions: regular families typically yield root-\(n\) rates, whereas compactly supported laws may admit faster, boundary-driven rates. We question whether a single estimator, without knowledge of the density's shape, can adapt to the instance-wise optimal estimation rate, as an oracle that knows the underlying location family can.
